condition.expression: no_confirmed_short AND vin_present AND en_present AND NOT rail_voltage_present

next_steps.action: Re-measure LDO VOUT pin directly at the pin (not just at a downstream test point). If VOUT is correct at the pin but missing downstream, the fault is the trace / via / fuse. If VOUT is missing at the pin, the LDO is dead.

measure.what: LDO VOUT pin voltage (at the pin)
measure.where: LDO VOUT pin (consult datasheet for pin number)
measure.expected: Per LDO datasheet fixed-output value (e.g. 3.3 V for TLV70033).
measure.safety: Probe the pin, not the via, to isolate trace faults.

interpretations.then: Trace / via / fuse between LDO and load is open. Repair the trace or replace the fuse.

interpretations.if_result: VOUT missing at the pin despite good VIN/EN
interpretations.then: LDO is dead. Replace with a verified-compatible part (check pinout AND output voltage suffix AND EN polarity).
Wrong-output-voltage part installed (e.g. TLV70018 instead of TLV70033) OR feedback divider wrong. Verify the part marking and the divider.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need LDO datasheet for VOUT pin number and expected output voltage.
